reason: Counting customers per creator is exactly what I needed last time I got burned, but I don't have time for another app and I don't want my staff fumbling with coupon links and PINs at a busy front desk. Free doesn't help if it costs me attention and still means paying creators who might bring nobody.
objection: I don't have time to learn another app, and a small beta team makes me wonder if it'll still be around or working in three months.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing another salon or gym near me show real customer counts from a creator post, with setup done for me so my staff only has to tap redeem.
